# Runtime dependencies for the NATIVE (no-Docker) app.
# Key difference vs requirements.txt: NO torch/torchvision/timm (that's the
# multi-GB weight). The DINOv2 model runs via ONNX Runtime against a
# pre-exported models/dinov2_vits14.onnx (generated by scripts/export_dinov2_onnx.py).
# Also drops the Postgres drivers — the native app uses SQLite (stdlib).

numpy<2
